# aiprovider_cluster (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the cluster. Must be unique.

### Optional

- `model` (String) AI model used by the cluster (case-insensitive).
- `replicas` (Number) Number of replicas for the cluster. Must be >= 0.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-generated unique identifier of the cluster.
